method: Complete pinned Russian catalog read and Git/SHA256 verification. Parsed all active entries; ran installed msgfmt --check --check-format into private temporary MO output, no system locale install.
findings: 264 active entries match template count;24 have nonempty translations including two fuzzy candidate labels.22 nonfuzzy translations provide only partial coverage.
msgfmt structural/format checks exit0 with no diagnostics. This checks catalog compilation and declared format strings, not natural-language semantics or live localization.
Fatal-signal newline version has empty active translation while older non-newline translated entry is obsolete. Obsolete content is not active translation coverage.
Read failures, changed-mtime replay, early shutdown, interruptions, cache/reflink uncertainty, size parsing and most CLI settings remain untranslated; fallback source language is expected.
Fuzzy duplicate-candidate labels translate as duplicates, omitting candidate distinction; fuzzy entries are not credited as current verified translations.
Russian plural formula is present but no pluralized entries use it; parenthesized file/group forms remain awkward and cannot qualify grammar for arbitrary counts.
Inherited truncated format-macro keys from POT remain empty here. Successful msgfmt cannot repair mismatched lookup keys or source messages absent from catalog.
limits: No application launch under Russian locale, pixel review or production localization change.
